scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @screenvault/shared run build && pnpm --filter @screenvault/types run build && pnpm --filter @screenvault/ui run build
scripts.build: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter @screenvault/api run build && pnpm --filter @screenvault/admin run build && pnpm --filter @screenvault/desktop run build
scripts.dev: pnpm run build:packages && concurrently -n api,admin,desktop -c cyan,green,magenta "pnpm --filter @screenvault/api dev" "pnpm --filter @screenvault/admin dev" "pnpm --filter @screenvault/desktop dev"
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter @screenvault/shared exec tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && pnpm --filter @screenvault/types exec tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && pnpm --filter @screenvault/ui exec tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && pnpm --filter @screenvault/api exec tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && pnpm --filter @screenvault/admin exec tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && pnpm --filter @screenvault/desktop exec tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
